pairs.why: B's kit fills more of the card with tighter margins and a larger bass drum like the real card's close hero framing, while A is small and spread out with lots of empty stage.
B is a closer, larger view with the lifebuoy and bollard as big hero shapes filling the card, whereas A shrinks the dock to a small distant strip with lots of open water.
A's truss runs off both side edges and the light sits big in the lower-left like the real card, while B's truss floats as a tilted bar with margins all round.
A's console spans nearly the full card width with the headphones tucked at lower right, matching the real card's wide fill, though B is similar and neither has the real card's diagonal tilt.
Both topiaries are centered with similar height, width and breathing room, so framing gives no reason to choose.
B's sandals are larger and nearly touch the card edges on a diagonal like the real card, while A's sit smaller with more empty background.
A's ball fills most of the card with small margins like the real hero, whereas B's ball is noticeably smaller with a lot of empty sand and sky.
A's gloves are larger, run close to the left edge and bottom, and fill the lower card like the real card, while B's pair is smaller and floats with more margin.
